calls.statement:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at, p.sku, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl,
       min(sale_date) AS d0, max(sale_date) AS d1, sum(quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT sku) AS skus,
       sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows,
       sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty,
       count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS l0, max(etl_loaded_at) AS l1
FROM src

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT so.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, so.units_sold, so.lines, so.staff_units, COALESCE(rt.units_returned,0) AS units_returned
FROM sold so
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = so.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN ret rt ON rt.sku = so.sku
ORDER BY so.units_sold DESC, so.sku
LIMIT 10

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date AS d, units_sold, receipts, net_sales_before_returns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS days_ctl, SUM(c.units_sold) AS ctl_units, SUM(m.units) AS my_units, SUM(c.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net, SUM(m.net) AS my_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.units_sold <> m.units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_unit_diff,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ctl_days_without_mine
FROM ctl c LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.d = c.d
